nodes.speaker: Capulet
nodes.text: Can I demand.

nodes.speaker: Montague
nodes.text: But I can give thee more

nodes.speaker: Montague
nodes.text: For I will raise her statue in pure gold;

nodes.speaker: Montague
nodes.text: That while Verona by that name is known,

nodes.speaker: Montague
nodes.text: There shall no figure at such rate be set

nodes.speaker: Montague
nodes.text: As that of true and faithful Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Capulet
nodes.text: As rich shall Romeo's by his lady's lie;

nodes.speaker: Capulet
nodes.text: Poor sacrifices of our enmity!

nodes.speaker: Prince
nodes.text: A glooming peace this morning with it brings;

nodes.speaker: Prince
nodes.text: The sun, for sorrow, will not show his head

nodes.speaker: Prince
nodes.text: Go hence, to have more talk of these sad things;

nodes.speaker: Prince
nodes.text: Some shall be pardon'd, and some punished

nodes.speaker: Prince
nodes.text: For never was a story of more woe

nodes.speaker: Prince
nodes.text: Than this of Juliet and her Romeo.
Exuent

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, what a story!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That was some heavy stuff in the end there...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But we made it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now... I exuent!
